facts.fact: Connected TV accounted for 60% of publisher video expenditure in FY26, up from 51% in FY25, according to the page.
facts.quote: Connected TV now accounts for 60% of publisher video expenditure — up from 51% in FY25

facts.fact: Connected TV's share of publisher video expenditure was 51% in FY25, according to the page.
Programmatic advertising is the automated buying and selling of digital advertising inventory using software, data and algorithms, rather than manual one-to-one negotiation.
facts.quote: Programmatic advertising is the automated buying and selling of digital advertising inventory using software, data and algorithms.

facts.fact: The page describes the programmatic process as a five-step sequence: a user visits a digital property, an ad opportunity becomes available, advertisers evaluate it, a buying decision is made, and the ad is displayed.
facts.quote: Programmatic advertising works through a five-step sequence that plays out in a fraction of a second.

facts.fact: The page names three main components of programmatic technology: demand-side platforms, supply-side platforms and ad exchanges.
facts.quote: Three main components move the pieces: demand-side platforms, supply-side platforms and ad exchanges.

facts.fact: The page presents a simplified programmatic flow of Advertiser → DSP → ad exchange → SSP → publisher, and notes that real ecosystems often have additional intermediaries.
facts.quote: Advertiser → DSP → ad exchange → SSP → publisher. Treat that as a sketch, not a blueprint.

facts.fact: Real-time bidding is one buying method within programmatic advertising, alongside private marketplaces, preferred deals and programmatic guaranteed arrangements.
facts.quote: RTB is one buying method among several, including private marketplaces, preferred deals and programmatic guaranteed arrangements.
